payload.summary: Historical Genesis monitoring demonstrates that healthy-looking activity proxies can decouple from useful output: after stabilization, raw trace shows +349 births, +348 deaths, +409 mutations, +36% average fitness and emotion-spread recovery while producing zero new crystals and zero fusions, with a 51% caching monoculture. Earlier regime had watchdog crash-loop, frozen state and total emotion saturation. Healing logs add unreachable-threshold, startup-grace, cumulative-state and sign-math failures.
actions: Emergenz/GWT: keep dynamics, output utility and causal outcome separate; never score emergence by activity/fitness alone.
Harness: add threshold-reachability, saturation, dead-gate/schema-migration, monoculture, process-liveness and semantic-readiness trajectory tests.
FRANK/ClayCode: state-machine thresholds must be validated against reachable distributions and explicit hysteresis, not static ranges.
UnifiedDB/ClayGraph: readiness must include initialized semantic content/source epoch, not merely healthy processes.
